baseline.populationLimit: This is a fixed 45-record follow-up, not a fresh whole-population audit. New arrivals after the previous independent snapshot are not silently counted as independently reviewed.

method: Re-read the prior primary assessments for every record; targeted primary-site search, product/case/developer pages, live public fetches and vendor/entity cross-checks for closure. Unchanged exclusion assessments reuse the detailed catalogue reads from the preceding pass. Search absence is never evidence of ineligibility. Not every site was newly fetched in this pass.
interpretation: Concrete original hardware/software/process development qualifies without patents, exclusive IP, invention of upstream components or a separate retail product. A commissioned project is not automatically excluded when the source specifically establishes original substantive technical development and continuing product work; ordinary vendor configuration, resale and generic agency/consulting remain excluded. Customer brands and technology are not reassigned to contractors.
warning: Do not execute the earlier Cyberlink or Trias recommendations. This report supersedes their eligibility recommendations only; no manifest or production operation was changed. Main must review and reconcile staged operations.

unresolved.question: Which named original technology is developed by the Swiss operation, rather than global Accenture Labs or local client integration? Current primary research/careers and the Zurich hub announcement do not settle local attribution.
Does AutoMate develop the branded insurance engine or license an external engine? The primary platform homepage confirms a real product, but developer identity remains unestablished.

Does Blackpoints author a substantive maintained application/component beyond the specifically documented CAMAC integrations and partner products? Existing catalogue is readable; no technology author is yet established for the exception.

Which changed manufacturing method or design is developed by Ecoparts beyond standard laser-sinter manufacture of MoldMasters/customer designs? Production is established, but the inspected process descriptions do not isolate an original process contribution.

Is there a maintained original Evolyze platform beyond the named customer MVP and data-engineering delivery? Existing pages document customer engineering, but not a specific continuing company technology.
Is the Swiss operation still present, and which maintained technology is attributable to it? Current official office information omits Switzerland; omission alone is not closure evidence.

Does icentic still develop the beppo technology, or was that development spun into beppo? Beppo's own about page now confirms an actual icentic spin-off, stronger than founder overlap, but current development is explicitly at beppo.

Is the Winterthur location still occupied after absorption into Adnovum? The technology business has a supported successor; reconcile identity/location, not eligibility by deleting a historical profile.

Which concrete original assembly or control design is attributable to the firm beyond its general commissioned-development catalogue? No patent is required; a specific design example would resolve the remaining attribution gap.

Who develops the actual glare-calculation engine or original model? The official methodology establishes specialist analysis; the federal tool overview corroborates the service but does not identify its software author.

What concrete original physical-AI research system or output belongs to this entity? The fresh primary page still gives broad research/client-sector claims without an attributable system. Do not classify a quiet lab as inactive.

What original assay, research method or test platform does MIS develop beyond the published standard-method testing catalogue? The fresh history and services remain substantive contract-testing evidence but do not resolve the research-output exception.

Does onmit maintain an original software platform beyond the customer's Teacher Switch app and vendor services? The primary licence terms explicitly distinguish third-party products, but do not resolve the specific original-development exception.

What substantive original maintained component underlies SelfService/MediaLink? Current primary home page explicitly credits SelfService app development, but does not distinguish continuing platform development from customer implementation.
What is the Swiss entity relationship to Reasoning Machines Inc and its concrete research programme? Public primary material remains too sparse; no inactivity or service-only exclusion inferred.
Who develops publicloud Marketplace? The current subsidiary/product page confirms the real portal, not whether it is original software or licensed channel tooling.

Can Step-X's ZOE developer attribution be confirmed by a primary publisher/store record? A third-party app mirror names Step-X as publisher, but an accessible first-party publisher record was not recovered. ENOVIA/Scribe remain vendor products.

Which actual aerial robot, controller or original research prototype is developed by this entity? The freshly read solutions page still supplies generic autonomous-inspection claims, not a specific attributable system.
Does the demonstrated order-processing offering have an original maintained common engine? The fresh homepage establishes customised workflows and integrations, but not that technical attribution.

Does UMB's current Near-Zero-Downtime approach contain original maintained software/process technology beyond SAP-instance failover configuration? The current page positively attributes the concept, but its detail describes a setup rather than identified original code. Do not use the divested mesoneer products.

Does the current Dextra system include a substantive original maintained technology beyond customer-specific LLM/data integration? The fresh detailed case proves a working development programme, but not that distinction. Startup age and lack of commercial release are not exclusion grounds.

Who develops the customer reporting portal or monitoring/control system? Public service descriptions and targeted searches still do not identify its author; datacentre operation alone does not settle this exception.
